title: Blocks, inserts, attributes and symbols
objective: Implement the next bounded AutoCAD-class capability for blocks, inserts, attributes and symbols with canonical ownership, identity, rendering/selectability, deterministic serialization, undo/redo and Web/Electron parity while preserving frozen Architecture v1.1.
acceptance_criteria: Block definitions have deterministic canonical identity and explicit ownership/provenance.
Block inserts/materialized instances have deterministic canonical identity, ordering and source-definition linkage without creating a competing application authority.
Attributes are explicitly owned by the appropriate block definition/insert semantics and remain canonical, deterministic and selectable/renderable where required.
Symbol semantics required by the roadmap are explicit, deterministic and bounded to this work item.
Creation and supported edits form the required atomic canonical revision and integrate with existing undo/redo without phantom or orphaned entities.
Deletion of definitions, inserts and owned attributes follows a deterministic policy and cannot leave hidden canonical or orphaned entities.
Invalid and unsupported cases fail with the existing typed error taxonomy before mutation.
Web and Electron execute the same engine-free semantic command path and converge on equivalent affected serialized state.
Required roadmap browser workflows exercise block/insert/attribute/symbol creation, visibility and selection through the real UI, including negative/unsupported cases.
COMPAT-CAD-005 through COMPAT-CAD-008 verified behavior remains regression-green.
Architecture v1.1, Construction Graph authority and engine/adapter boundaries remain unchanged unless an approved ACR is required.
non_goals: No hatch/annotation/dimension/inspection expansion; COMPAT-CAD-010 owns that work.
No durable SAVE/OPEN or multi-instance persistence; COMPAT-CAD-011/infrastructure owns that work.
No DXF import/export; COMPAT-CAD-012 owns that work.
No layouts/sheets/viewports/plot; COMPAT-CAD-013 owns that work.
No broad command-language/options/help expansion; COMPAT-CAD-014 owns that work.
No generalized undo/history/long-session expansion; COMPAT-CAD-015 owns that work.
No architecture change without an approved ACR.
No benchmark score increase claim without a measured full-corpus rerun.
risk_assumptions: COMPAT-CAD-008 is VERIFIED at physical product merge 3854f539 and is the immediate predecessor baseline.
Existing engine-free shared geometry and canonical revision semantics are sufficient for the bounded block capability; any native engine dependency must remain behind EngineAdapterBundle.
Definition/insert/attribute previews remain presentation state until canonical commit.
Ownership/provenance must remain domain-owned and deterministic.
Historical governance defects remain isolated from implementation validity.
evidence_requirements: Deterministic automated tests for definitions, inserts, attributes, symbols, invalid and unsupported cases.
Web/Electron parity evidence over the affected semantic command stream.
Exact-head deployment and independent browser-agent evidence for the assigned Golden workflows.
Revision-bound governance evidence sufficient for independent Architect verification.

Submit COMPAT-CAD-009 for independent Architect verification. Revision-bound implementer evidence recorded; exact-head CI, deployment and independent browser-agent evidence are Architect-owned gates.

Independent Architect review identified revision-binding drift plus material CC009 acceptance gaps: INSERT provenance index reuse after deletion is possible; insertProvenance.blockId is not validated against the canonical blockId; and the mandatory independent exact-deployment browser gate for G5/G7/G8 is not supplied. These must be closed before approval.

Return CC009 for bounded remediation. Preserve the existing implementation where sound, but make provenance ownership internally consistent and monotonic, add deterministic regression tests for deletion/reinsert and malformed provenance, and provide the required exact-head independent browser-agent evidence for G5/G7/G8 before the next return.
transitions.failure_reason: CC009 is not verification-complete. The implementation can generate duplicate insertIndex values after deletions, permits provenance blockId to disagree with the canonical blockRef blockId, and lacks the required independent browser-agent verification of the assigned roadmap workflows. The current PR/record also had stale revision bindings before reconciliation.
